spec.description: UptimeRobot monitors exported by https://github.com/lekpamartin/uptimerobot_exporter (UptimeRobot API v3)

spec.title: Monitors
spec.description: Current status, 24h uptime and response time of each monitor. Response times require UPTIMEROBOT_RESPONSE_TIMES=true on the exporter.

spec.title: Status history
spec.description: Status of each monitor over time.

spec.title: Uptime (24h)
spec.description: 24 hours uptime computed by UptimeRobot, lowest first.

spec.title: Response time (average)
spec.description: Average response time over UPTIMEROBOT_RESPONSE_TIME_WINDOW. Empty unless the exporter runs with UPTIMEROBOT_RESPONSE_TIMES=true.

spec.title: Response time min / avg / max
spec.description: Min, average and max response time, averaged over the selected monitors.

spec.title: API status
spec.description: 1 when the UptimeRobot API answered, 0 on error or while backing off after a rate limit.

spec.title: API query duration
spec.description: Duration of the UptimeRobot API queries (0 when results come from the exporter cache).

spec.title: Exporter
spec.description: Whether the last UptimeRobot API query succeeded (uptimerobot_up). Check the exporter logs when it is in error (rate limit, invalid API key...).

spec.title: Average uptime (24h)
spec.description: Average of the 24 hours uptime of the selected monitors.

spec.title: Monitor quota
spec.description: Monitors used compared to the plan limit.

spec.title: Uptime robot v2
